description: Import and Export Control Department - Import and Export ( Control) Regulations No. 10 of 2025
categorisation: The gazette content is the promulgation of new regulations (Imports and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 10 of 2025) under an existing Act. It details specific legal and regulatory changes to import/export controls, including exemptions, procedures, and amendments to previous regulations. While it is signed by a named Minister, the core content is entirely about establishing a legal/regulatory framework for customs and trade, not about the minister's portfolio responsibilities or a government personnel/structural change. Therefore, it falls under the specialized Legal/Regulatory category.
